# Prep
```{r}
out_wait_shp_small <- "../shared-svn/projects/matsim-gunma/data/processed/drt/wait_times-small-gunma.shp"
out_wait_shp_large <- "../shared-svn/projects/matsim-gunma/data/processed/drt/wait_times-large-gunma.shp"

in_drt_legs_small <- "/Users/jakob/git/matsim-gunma/output-drt-500/gunma.output_drt_legs_drt.csv"
in_drt_legs_medium <-  "/Users/jakob/git/matsim-gunma/output-drt-750/gunma.output_drt_legs_drt.csv"
in_drt_legs_large <- "/Users/jakob/git/matsim-gunma/output-drt-1500/gunma.output_drt_legs_drt.csv"
```


landuse
```{r}
district_dict <- data.frame(
  district_jp = c(
    "前橋市", "高崎市", "桐生市", "伊勢崎市", "太田市",
    "沼田市", "館林市", "渋川市", "藤岡市", "富岡市",
    "安中市", "みどり市", "北群馬郡", "多野郡", "甘楽郡",
    "吾妻郡", "利根郡", "佐波郡", "邑楽郡"
  ),
  district_en = c(
    "Maebashi City", "Takasaki City", "Kiryu City", "Isesaki City", "Ota City",
    "Numata City", "Tatebayashi City", "Shibukawa City", "Fujioka City", "Tomioka City",
    "Annaka City", "Midori City", "Kitagunma District", "Tano District", "Kanra District",
    "Agatsuma District", "Tone District", "Sawa District", "Ora District"
  ),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

gunma_shp <- st_read("../shared-svn/projects/matsim-gunma/data/raw/01_shapefiles/jis_zones/N03-20_200101.shp",options = "ENCODING=CP932")  %>% mutate(district_jp = case_when(is.na(N03_003)~ N03_004, .default = N03_003)) %>% left_join(district_dict) %>% st_transform(2450) 

gunma_shp_landuse <- gunma_shp %>%
  separate_wider_delim(district_en, delim = " ", names = c(NA,"landuse"), cols_remove = FALSE) %>% 
  st_as_sf()  %>% filter(str_starts(N03_007,"10")) %>% select(zone = N03_007, landuse) %>% group_by(zone) %>% summarise(landuse = first(landuse))
```


read and clean

```{r}
# SMALL FLEET SIZE = 500 vehicles
drt_trips_raw_small <- read_delim(in_drt_legs_small) 

drt_trips_cleaned_small <- drt_trips_raw_small %>%
  mutate(hour = floor(submissionTime / 3600)) %>%
  mutate(hour_binned = case_when(hour < 6 ~ "00-05", hour<10 ~ "06-09", hour <16 ~ "10-15", hour <21 ~ "16-20", .default = "21-Inf")) %>% 
  mutate(directRideTime = directRideTime/60, inVehicleRideTime = inVehicleRideTime/60) %>% 
  st_as_sf(coords = c("fromX","fromY"), crs = 2450) %>% 
  st_join(gunma_shp_landuse) %>% 
  filter(!is.na(landuse))


# SMALL FLEET SIZE = 500 vehicles
drt_trips_raw_medium <- read_delim(in_drt_legs_medium) 

drt_trips_cleaned_medium <- drt_trips_raw_medium %>%
  mutate(hour = floor(submissionTime / 3600)) %>%
  mutate(hour_binned = case_when(hour < 6 ~ "00-05", hour<10 ~ "06-09", hour <16 ~ "10-15", hour <21 ~ "16-20", .default = "21-Inf")) %>% 
  mutate(directRideTime = directRideTime/60, inVehicleRideTime = inVehicleRideTime/60) %>% 
  st_as_sf(coords = c("fromX","fromY"), crs = 2450) %>% 
  st_join(gunma_shp_landuse) %>% 
  filter(!is.na(landuse))



# LARGE FLEET SIZE = 1500 vehicles 
drt_trips_raw_large <- read_delim(in_drt_legs_large) 


drt_trips_cleaned_large <- drt_trips_raw_large %>%
  mutate(hour = floor(submissionTime / 3600)) %>%
  mutate(hour_binned = case_when(hour < 6 ~ "00-05", hour<10 ~ "06-09", hour <16 ~ "10-15", hour <21 ~ "16-20", .default = "21-Inf")) %>% 
  mutate(directRideTime = directRideTime/60, inVehicleRideTime = inVehicleRideTime/60) %>% 
  st_as_sf(coords = c("fromX","fromY"), crs = 2450) %>% 
  st_join(gunma_shp_landuse) %>% 
  filter(!is.na(landuse))
```
## Wait Time per District

### Small Fleet Size
```{r}


# Summary Stats for entire study area (53 minutes)
drt_trips_cleaned_small %>% summarise(mean_wait = as.integer(mean(waitTime)), median_wait = as.integer(median(waitTime)), n = n(), max_wait = as.integer(max(waitTime))) %>% st_drop_geometry()


# On the level of JIS zones:
zone_stats_small <- drt_trips_cleaned_small %>%   
  group_by(zone) %>% 
  summarise(mean_wait = as.integer(mean(waitTime)), median_wait = as.integer(median(waitTime)), n = n()) %>%
  mutate(zone = as.character(zone)) %>% st_drop_geometry() %>% left_join(gunma_shp_landuse) %>% st_as_sf()

# plot it
zone_stats_small  %>% 
  mutate(median_wait = median_wait / 60, mean_wait = mean_wait / 60) %>% 
  tm_shape() + 
  tm_polygons(fill = "mean_wait", title = "Mean Wait\nTime (min)") + 
  tm_basemap("Stadia.StamenTerrainBackground", api = "996f61fe-f7b6-4641-bb2b-555eca9cdd21") +
  tm_layout(legend.outside = FALSE,
  legend.position = c("right", "top"))

zone_stats_small %>% st_drop_geometry() %>%  summarise( max_mean = max(mean_wait))

zone_stats_small %>% select(typ_wt = mean_wait) %>%
st_write(out_wait_shp_small)

```

### Large Fleet Size
```{r}

# Summary Stats for entire study area (5 minutes)
drt_trips_cleaned_large %>% summarise(mean_wait = as.integer(mean(waitTime)), median_wait = as.integer(median(waitTime)), n = n(), max_wait = as.integer(max(waitTime))) %>% st_drop_geometry()


# On the level of JIS zones:
zone_stats_large <- drt_trips_cleaned_large %>%   
  group_by(zone) %>% 
  summarise(mean_wait = as.integer(mean(waitTime)), median_wait = as.integer(median(waitTime)), n = n()) %>%
  mutate(zone = as.character(zone)) %>% st_drop_geometry() %>% left_join(gunma_shp_landuse) %>% st_as_sf()

# plot it
zone_stats_large  %>% 
  mutate(median_wait = median_wait / 60, mean_wait = mean_wait / 60) %>% 
  tm_shape() + tm_polygons(fill = "mean_wait",    title = "Mean Wait\nTime (min)") + tm_basemap("Stadia.StamenTerrainBackground", api = "996f61fe-f7b6-4641-bb2b-555eca9cdd21") +
  tm_layout(  legend.outside = FALSE,
  legend.position = c("right", "top"))


# from the zonal means, find the maximum (as a default value for the DRT estimator)
zone_stats_large %>% st_drop_geometry() %>%  summarise(max_mean = max(mean_wait))

zone_stats_large %>% select(typ_wt = mean_wait) %>%
st_write(out_wait_shp_large)

```
  ### Comparison of fleet sizes
```{r}

fig_boxplot_wait_compare <- drt_trips_cleaned_small %>% select(waitTime) %>% mutate(fleet_size = 500) %>% 
  bind_rows(drt_trips_cleaned_medium %>% select(waitTime) %>% mutate(fleet_size = 1000)) %>% 
  bind_rows(drt_trips_cleaned_large %>% select(waitTime) %>% mutate(fleet_size = 1500)) %>% 
  mutate(fleet_size = factor(fleet_size)) %>% 
  mutate(waitTime = waitTime/60) %>% 
  st_drop_geometry() %>% ggplot() + geom_boxplot(aes(fleet_size,waitTime))+
  theme_minimal(base_size = 20) +
  labs(x = "Fleet Size", y = "Wait Time (min)")

fig_boxplot_wait_compare

ggsave(fig_boxplot_wait_compare, filename = "/Users/jakob/Dropbox/Documents/04_Work-VSP/007_papers/2026-03b-hEART/figures/results_wait_boxplot_compare.png")
```

```{r}

  bind_rows(drt_trips_cleaned_medium %>% select(directRideTime,inVehicleRideTime) %>% mutate(fleet_size = 1000)) %>% 
  bind_rows(drt_trips_cleaned_large %>% select(directRideTime,inVehicleRideTime) %>% mutate(fleet_size = 1500)) %>% 
  mutate(fleet_size = factor(fleet_size)) %>% 
  st_drop_geometry() %>% 
  ggplot(aes(directRideTime,inVehicleRideTime)) + geom_bin2d(bins = 40) +
      scale_fill_viridis_c(trans = "log10")+
```

# Occupancy
```{r}
occ_500 <- read_delim("/Users/jakob/git/matsim-gunma/output-drt-500/gunma.output_occupancy_time_profiles_drt.txt")
occ_750 <- read_delim("/Users/jakob/git/matsim-gunma/output-drt-750/gunma.output_occupancy_time_profiles_drt.txt")

occ_1000 <- read_delim("/Users/jakob/git/matsim-gunma/output-drt-1000/gunma.output_occupancy_time_profiles_drt.txt")
occ_1500 <- read_delim("/Users/jakob/git/matsim-gunma/output-drt-1500/gunma.output_occupancy_time_profiles_drt.txt")


occ_500 %>% mutate(fleet_size = 500) %>% 
  bind_rows(occ_750 %>% mutate(fleet_size = 750)) %>% 
  bind_rows(occ_1000 %>% mutate(fleet_size = 1000)) %>% 
  bind_rows(occ_1500 %>% mutate(fleet_size = 1500)) %>% 
  filter(time <= hm("24:00")) %>% 
  pivot_longer(-c(time,fleet_size), names_to = "status", values_to = "n") %>% 
  # mutate(status = factor(status, levels = c("STAY","0 pax", "1 pax", "2 pax", "3 pax", "4 pax"))) %>% 
  ggplot() + 
  scale_x_time(minor_breaks = "1 hour", date_breaks = "3 hours",date_labels = "%H") +
  geom_area(aes(time, n, fill = status)) + 
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "STAY" = "gray",
    "0 pax" = "white",
    "1 pax" = "yellow",
    "2 pax" = "orange",
    "3 pax" = "red",
    "4 pax" = "purple"
  )) +
  facet_grid(~fleet_size)+
  theme_minimal(base_size = 16) + 
  labs(x = "Time", y = "Number of Vehicles")
```



# DEPRECATED
```{r}
trips_100 <- read_delim("output-drt-100/gunma.output_drt_legs_drt.csv") 
trips_1500 <- read_delim("output-drt-1500/gunma.output_drt_legs_drt.csv") 

# 986 minutes (16 hours) for 100 vehicles 
trips_100 %>% summarise(waitTime = mean(waitTime)/60)

# 23 minutes for 1500 vehicles (why is this so much higher than the 9 minutes in the taxi contrib...)
trips_1500 %>% summarise(waitTime_mean = mean(waitTime)/60, waitTime_median = median(waitTime)/60)

trips_1500 %>% ggplot() + geom_histogram(aes(waitTime))

```
